event_chain.summary: Malicious JS injected into Safe{Wallet} front end
Bybit signers approve manipulated cold-wallet transaction

summary: On February 21, 2025 North Korea's Lazarus Group (TraderTraitor) stole about $1.5 billion in ETH from Dubai-based exchange Bybit. Attackers had compromised a Safe{Wallet} developer's machine and injected malicious JavaScript into the Safe{Wallet} web interface served to Bybit, so that when Bybit's signers approved a routine transfer from an ETH multisig cold wallet to a warm wallet, the interface displayed the correct address while the signed transaction changed the wallet's smart contract logic and gave the attacker control. The FBI attributed the theft to North Korea; Bybit offered a 10% bounty and later sued North Korea and Lazarus.
